name: Clay
summary: Clay's Public API: people and company search, saved enrichment routines, and queries over your Clay tables.

api_key.description: A personal Clay Public API key (API and CLI > API keys in the Clay app); the legacy workspace API key does not work. Sent in the clay-api-key header.

notes: The key acts as its user, within that user's workspace access and monthly credit limit.
Per-workspace rate limit: a 429 carries Retry-After in seconds, and X-RateLimit-* headers when available.
Two paging styles: cursor (send back cursor until it is absent) and stateful iterators (call again while has_more is true).
Waterfall enrichment runs through routines built in the Clay app; the API has no generic enrich-a-person call.
Batch (JSONL) routine runs, filters-mode search (deprecated), workflow-run queries and Audiences privacy deletion are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get the authenticated user
endpoints.summary: The Clay user and workspace the API key belongs to.

endpoints.name: Get workspace credit balances
endpoints.summary: Workspace credit balances and the key owner's monthly credit limit.

endpoints.name: Get the search query reference
endpoints.summary: Markdown reference of Clay's advanced search query grammar and queryable people and company fields.
notes: Read it before writing a query for clay.search.create.

endpoints.name: Start a people or company search
endpoints.summary: Creates a search from a Clay advanced search query; answers with search_id and the detected source_type (people or companies).

query.description: A Clay advanced search query (grammar from clay.search.reference). Count-mode and jobs queries are not supported.

notes: A read over POST. Returns no rows: page them with clay.search.next. A 402 means not enough credits.

endpoints.name: Get the next page of search results
endpoints.summary: The next page of people or company records for a search.
notes: A read over POST on a stateful iterator: each call consumes the page it returns. Call again while has_more is true.

endpoints.name: Query Clay tables
endpoints.summary: Records from one or more of the workspace's Clay tables, with filters, joins, grouping and aggregates.

query.description: {tables: [{id, alias}], select, filter, join, group_by, order_by, field_mode: names|ids}; tables is required (1-5).

notes: A read over POST. Pages run least-recently-updated first and pick up concurrent writes, so a record can repeat: deduplicate by id. A custom order_by disables cursor paging.

endpoints.name: Run a routine on up to 100 items
endpoints.summary: Starts an asynchronous run of a saved Clay routine (for example an enrichment waterfall) over 1-100 input items.

items.description: 1-100 items {id, inputs}; id is your key (max 64 chars), inputs the routine's input fields.

webhook_id.description: A registered Clay webhook to notify when the run finishes.

notes: Marked write: a routine runs whatever steps it was built with, which can spend credits and write to tables or other tools.
Poll clay.routines.results with the returned run id, or use a webhook.

endpoints.name: Get a routine run's progress and results
endpoints.summary: Status and paginated results of an asynchronous routine run.
